'''CryoBan projectors''', manufactured by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]], were originally designed to [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|extinguish]] [[Fire/Legends|fires]] aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] using a supercooling chemical agent. However, independent operators soon discovered that removing the safety nozzles from CryoBan projectors could convert them into lethal [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. Many [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] kept several of these stashed in strategic locations around their ships, both to extinguish fires and, if necessary, repel boarders.<ref name="Fly" />
